full_judgment: Shahabuddin Ahmed, J: These two appeals have come before us by special leave and they have been heard analogously since a common question of law is involved therein. The question is whether the question of benami transaction can be gone into and determined in a proceeding for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. In both the cases, learned respective Judges of the Single Bench of the High Court Division answered the question in the negative and allowed the pre-emption sought for. Consequently, pre-emptees are the appellants before us.
